$comment: Kenney's rifle points +Z with the bulky receiver at -Z (measured: the +Z half has the smaller XY cross-section, i.e. the barrel). This project's contract is -Z forward, so yaw 180. Scaled along Z, not Y: a gun is sized by its length -- scaling by height would size it by its sights. Mounts are in FINISHED coordinates, taken off the measured geometry: the barrel tip sits at y=0.31 in the source frame, the pistol grip bottoms out at y=0 around z=-0.05.
author: Kenney
